description: Client monitoring and collections follow-up log. One row per follow-up event on a client; the credit engine counts at_risk and default rows to adjust the internal credit score.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The client (borrower) this follow-up tracks. Same id space as loans.clientId and creditScores.clientId.

fields.name: riskStatus
fields.description: Monitoring state. Allowed values: on_track, at_risk, default. Read by sp_creditScore_data (-8 per at_risk row, -20 per default row). FK to clientFollowUps_status.riskStatus.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the follow-up / risk flag was raised.

fields.name: note
fields.description: Free-text follow-up note from the agent handling the case.

fields.name: assignedTo
fields.description: userId of the agent responsible for this follow-up.

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: When the next follow-up action is due.

fields.name: resolvedAt
fields.description: Timestamp set when the follow-up is closed / resolved.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A client may have many follow-up records over time; counts feed the credit score.

components.name: FollowUpListStep
components.description: IonList of follow-ups filtered by companyId, optional clientId and riskStatus. IonSearchbar + IonSelect (riskStatus) + infinite scroll. Each row shows client, riskStatus badge, dueDate.

components.name: FollowUpFormModal
components.description: IonModal create/edit form: IonSelect riskStatus (on_track / at_risk / default), reason, note, assignedTo, dueDate. Resolve action sets resolvedAt.
